card.name: Btu unit pieces and scattered others
card.fires_on: Mostly the pieces of the energy unit Btu (B, tu, U, slash) right after a heat flux number in building-science text. It also fires weakly on a few unrelated words like "high" before stocking rates or school, and "for"/"to" before re-examination or review.
